closure.verification: PyPI release metadata only; downloaded wheel METADATA and target pip resolver validation remain required

backend.offline_install_strategy: Use only the selected wheels with --no-index --find-links; preserve shipped requirements and constraints. Verify all hashes before target pip dry-run/install and forbid sdist fallback

frontend.verification: Public tarball URLs and SHA512 pins from the lockfile; no tarballs downloaded or npm scripts executed
frontend.offline_cache_strategy: In the isolated guest, add reviewed hash-verified tarballs using npm cache add --offline with private user/global config; run npm ci --offline with network disabled and prove install scripts need no missing payload

alpine.verification: Official HTTPS index metadata only; Q1 is the APK control checksum, not a whole-file SHA256. Verify index/package signatures and installed musl provider in the pinned base before installation
alpine.offline_install_strategy: Stage the signed indexes and complete hash-verified APK closure; use apk --no-network without --allow-untrusted. Preserve the base musl if its installed virtual provider satisfies the dependency; abort any unexpected base upgrade
